name: Western Sahara
facts: The African Union and several dozen UN member states, though many have withdrawn or frozen recognition
Morocco, which controls most of the territory; the UN lists it as a non-self-governing territory

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of black, white and green, with a red triangle at the hoist and a red crescent and star in the centre of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: Black, white, green and red are the Pan-Arab colours, and the crescent and star are symbols of Islam.

hook: Western Sahara is Palestine's flag with a red crescent and star added to the white stripe; Jordan puts a white star in the triangle instead.
trivia: The flag was adopted when the Polisario Front proclaimed the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic on 27 February 1976.
Western Sahara is the largest territory by area on the UN's list of non-self-governing territories.
